description: Ranks Finnish household electricity contracts (spot/pörssisähkö, fixed-price and hybrid = fixed price ± monthly usage effect) by estimated yearly cost for a given consumption. Spot contracts are priced with realized hourly Nord Pool prices weighted by a typical consumption pattern. Returns the cheapest contracts with margin or energy price, monthly fee, intro offers, price check date and data source. Without postal_code only contracts sold in the whole country are included. Prices exclude grid transmission and electricity tax.

annual_kwh.description: Yearly electricity consumption in kWh. If omitted, the home_type default is used.

ev_annual_kwh.description: Extra yearly kWh for electric car charging at night.

home_type.description: Typical Finnish home type; sets the consumption pattern and default yearly kWh (apartment 2000, terraced_house 5000, detached_house 6000, ground_source_heat_pump 10000, direct_electric_heating 18000).

language.description: Language for texts and links: fi (Finnish), sv (Swedish) or en (English). Use the user's language.

postal_code.description: Finnish postal code. Adds local contracts that are only sold in that area.

name: compare_electricity_contracts
title: Compare electricity contracts in Finland
